title: CoPirate code review installer configuration
description: Bindings for the workflows `copirate-review install` renders from their bases. Layers: the shipped defaults, then ~/.config/copirate-review/config.yaml, then the repo's own file. A later layer deep-merges over an earlier one; a null value deletes the key it names.

action_ref.description: The `uses:` ref every rendered workflow points its review step at. A moving major tag (promptctl/copirate-code-review-agent@v1) so a consumer tracks releases with no edit here. Rendered as `./` in the action's own source repo, which must review each PR with that PR's code.

commit_message.description: Subject of the commit the installer lands on the current branch when a rendered workflow changed.

secrets.description: Repo secrets to provision, as `SECRET_NAME: <credential source>`. Each is written to BOTH the Actions and the Dependabot store, and each is wired into every rendered workflow's `with:` block under its own name — declaring a secret provisions it and passes it, one fact in one place. Null deletes an inherited entry.

additionalProperties.description: Where this secret's value comes from on the machine running the installer, as `<scheme>:<name>`, or null to delete an inherited entry. `keychain:<item>` reads one macOS keychain generic-password item by service name; `env:<VAR>` reads an environment variable the installer was started with. The source is declared, never derived from the secret name: which account's token CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN holds varies by which account has quota, so the two sides are edited independently.

workflows.description: Workflow files to converge, keyed by their repo-relative path. Keyed rather than listed so a later layer can override one workflow's inputs, or add a second workflow, without restating either. Null deletes an inherited entry.

base.description: Base workflow name, resolved against .copirate-review/bases/, then ~/.config/copirate-review/bases/, then the bases shipped in this package — each as <name>.yml. A base is a complete, runnable GitHub Actions workflow; the installer parses it, rebinds the step whose id is `review`, and writes the result. A repo ships its own workflow shape by dropping a file with that name in the first directory; it never forks the installer.

inputs.description: Emitted into the review step's `with:` block, replacing whatever the base carried there. Deliberately open: every input action.yml accepts is reachable from here, and a new one needs no installer release. A name declared in `secrets` may not be repeated here — the rendered block would carry the key twice.

additionalProperties.description: A value the action reads as a string, or null to delete an inherited one.
